title: Always-on official game server
body: Dedicated server --name and idle mode (pause + 5 fps / 5 tps with no peers, ~3% CPU; wakes on peer_connected). Releases ship SoldatReborn.pck. soldat-master-server deploy/game-server.sh installs headless Godot 4.7.2 + the release pck as the soldat-game service next to the master, with an hourly update timer; master advertises SOLDAT_PUBLIC_IP for loopback registrations.
